title: Gem Swap
objective: Swap adjacent gems to match 3 or more of the same color and reach the 4000-point target before the 45-second timer runs out.
controls: Swipe a gem horizontally or vertically to swap it with an adjacent gem.
core_loop: Swipe gems to form matches of 3 or 4 -> trigger cascades and Row Blasters -> earn combo points and fill the Fever bar toward the target score.
features: Fever Time (x2 points and free blasters)
progression: Score escalates rapidly via Combo x2/x4 cascades, Row Blasters, and Fever Time x2 multiplier until reaching the 4000-point target and triggering Bonus Blast.
hook_idea: Massive Combo x4 'BRILLIANT!' cascade with Row Blaster laser clear (+1760 points) at t=7.5-9.2s
